svg.title: Azure Virtual Desktop across subscriptions and domains
svg.desc: One Microsoft Entra tenant holds the user accounts, synchronized from on-premises AD DS. Identity and connectivity platform subscriptions support the Azure Virtual Desktop subscription, and a shared services subscription supplies images, monitoring and automation. A bottom panel shows the two-way trust needed for single sign-on when hybrid joined session hosts are in a different Active Directory domain than the users.
svg.text: Microsoft Entra Connect Sync or Cloud Sync
Azure Virtual Desktop shared services subscription
There must be a two-way trust.
Without it, connections fall back to older
